title: Machine Learning Engineer

company_info.type: Iranian company dealing only with Iranian entities

job_description:
About Didar
Didar is a cloud-based B2B CRM that helps businesses streamline sales processes and customer relationship management through data-driven solutions.
We are currently looking for a Junior Machine Learning Engineer to help develop intelligent product features through data analysis and modeling. If you are passionate about problem-solving, data analysis, and identifying relationships between different data points, this role is a great fit for you.
Responsibilities
Develop and improve predictive models.
Identify user behavior patterns.
Optimize organizational processes using data.
Continuously evaluate and improve model performance.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
Experience working with complex datasets and proficiency in Python.
Ability to analyze data and identify patterns and trends.
Ability to predict user behavior and needs based on data.
Skills in optimizing models and algorithms.
Ability to analyze organizational processes and identify strengths and weaknesses.
Strong teamwork and effective communication skills.
